name: verifactu-mcp
description: Audita cadenas de huellas VERI*FACTU, genera el QR tributario de la AEAT y crea/valida Facturae 3.2.2. Pago por uso con créditos KeyFlint.
long_description: Calcula y audita la huella encadenada de VERI*FACTU, valida el XML de registros, genera el QR tributario y construye o valida facturas Facturae 3.2.2 contra el XSD oficial. Cada llamada descuenta créditos de tu licencia KeyFlint; pricing, credits_balance y las utilidades gratuitas no cobran.

tools.name: verifactu_hash
tools.description: Compute the VERI*FACTU fingerprint (huella, SHA-256) of one invoicing record.

tools.name: validate_invoice_chain
tools.description: Audit a VERI*FACTU chain of records (in generation order) given as JSON objects.

tools.name: validate_verifactu_xml
tools.description: Audit VERI*FACTU XML exported by an invoicing program (RegFactuSistemaFacturacion, a SOAP envelope, or any XML holding RegistroAlta / RegistroAnulacion elements, in document order).

tools.name: generate_verifactu_qr
tools.description: Generate the AEAT tax QR ("QR tributario") of an invoice: URL and image.

tools.name: build_facturae
tools.description: Build a Facturae 3.2.2 invoice (XML) from plain data, with totals computed and the official XSD checked.

tools.name: validate_facturae
tools.description: Validate a Facturae 3.2.2 file (.xml or signed .xsig) before sending it to FACe or a client.

tools.name: check_qr_url
tools.description: Check a tax QR URL read from an invoice: official AEAT host, path, parameters and formats. Free.

tools.name: validate_nif
tools.description: Check a Spanish NIF / NIE / CIF control character. Free.

tools.name: verifactu_calendar
tools.description: Legal deadlines for VERI*FACTU and mandatory B2B e-invoicing in Spain, with sources and what is still pending publication. Free.

tools.name: pricing
tools.description: Credit price of each tool and where to buy credits. Free.

tools.name: credits_balance
tools.description: Remaining credits on your KeyFlint license. Free.
